title: Concrete product-of-stalks Godement cofaces
statement: For a scheme $X$ and an $\mathcal O_X$-module sheaf $F$, set $T(F)=\prod_{x\in X} i_{x,*}F_x$ using the actual module skyscrapers. The germ unit and induced stalk maps define $T^n(F)$ and the unit insertions. $\mathrm{ModuleCupGodementModel}(X,F,A,a)$ says that $A^n=T^{n+1}(F)$, every coface is the corresponding unit insertion, and $a^0$ is the germ unit under the single-object and degree-zero extension identifications. It assumes no exactness or flasqueness.

source.place: Godement resolution; Lemma 20.30.1 (0FKS); monad multiplication and tensor compatibility: Banerjee, arXiv:1004.1491, section 1.1.4, pp. 15--16.

proof.text: Use the source library module skyscrapers and their stalk-evaluation and germ maps. Form their categorical product, define the germ unit by the product universal property, and define induced maps coordinatewise. Iterate these concrete objects, recursively insert the unit, and record the term, coface and augmentation equalities as a predicate. All objects and maps are real Lean constructions; no existence witness is selected.

proof_origin.by: R4 stage-3 worker; explicit Lean product-of-module-stalks construction and adaptation of the cited proof

lean.statement:
def ModuleCupGodementModel (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules)
    (A : CosimplicialObject X.Modules)
    (a : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor X.Modules 0).obj F ⟶
      (((alternatingCofaceMapComplex X.Modules).obj A).extend
        ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)) : Prop
